name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant researcher for perpetual futures markets. Read the day's market pulse, scan for signals and anomalies, see where smart money is positioned, research and compare Hyperliquid traders, score any wallet with the Quant Desk, browse Senpi's strategy catalog, review your own portfolio and trade history, and start, stop and resume simulations, which trade with virtual money and use your Senpi credits. Nothing in this plugin trades real money, moves funds or takes a strategy live.
